author: Lintuxer
tagline: Game server panel and daemon, with the node already wired up
description: Pterodactyl 1.14 — the game server panel together with its wings daemon in a single ZimaOS app. Panel, MariaDB, Redis and wings come up together, and a one-shot provision container creates the first administrator, a location and a node, then writes the daemon configuration itself. Elsewhere that node hand-shake is a manual copy-and-paste step; here the node is already there when you first log in. Game servers run as separate Docker containers next to the app, managed by wings through the host's Docker socket.

tips.before_install: Set APP_URL and NODE_FQDN to this machine's address before installing, and change ADMIN_PASSWORD. wings needs the Docker socket, which is root-equivalent access to the host. The first start takes about two minutes; wings restarts a few times until the provision container has written its configuration.

title: Pterodactyl
